name: SC-04
label: Likely R

Overwhelming fundraising gap: Timmons raised about $1.6M plus roughly $490K in outside support versus McClain's $33K and $1.2K cash on hand

model.rationale: An R+11 district, a renominated incumbent, and a roughly 50-to-1 fundraising advantage for Timmons all point to an easy hold, and prediction markets price the Democratic win chance at only a few percent. overview:
South Carolina's 4th District is solidly Republican territory, with a partisan index of R+11, and incumbent William Timmons returns as the Republican nominee after securing renomination. His Democratic opponent, Courtney McClain, has raised roughly $33,000 and reports about $1,200 on hand, while Timmons has raised about $1.6 million and benefited from nearly $490,000 in outside support.

No public general-election polling is available and no expert raters list the race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals: district lean, incumbency, money, and a favorable national environment for Republicans. Prediction markets give the Democrat only a few percent chance of winning. A Libertarian candidate is on the ballot but has raised under $500. The race is rated Safe Republican, with the main uncertainty being turnout in a contest receiving little attention.
